court: Bengaluru City Civil Court (LXXXIV Additional City Civil Judge, Commercial Court)
about: Digital Mailers Online Media Pvt. Ltd.
summary: A digital marketing company sued over four invoices (Feb to Sept 2017) for nine months of email marketing services. The court decreed Rs 6,16,120 with costs, plus 24% interest until the suit was filed and 9% after. The defendant filed no written statement and was treated as ex parte. The plaintiff's size is not stated. Appeal status not checked.
